description: Address review issues: implement missing geometry validations, fix snapshot ID, add integration tests, add dialog error handling, fix catch block, fix reconciliation traceability, make aspect ratio configurable
steps: Implement 9 missing geometry validation rules in validateGeometry (panel/gap-level checks, total dimension checks)
Fix GenerateActualBomButton to use actual snapshot ID from projectStore.currentSnapshot
Add integration tests that exercise runPipeline through the store with realistic mocked Supabase responses
Add error handling to all three dialog writes (check returned { error } and show error state)
Fix catch block in runPipeline to surface error info in pipelineErrors
Fix reconciliation to preserve per-zone traceability (use componentId in merge key)
Make aspect ratio warning configurable - only emit when maxAspectRatio is explicitly set
acceptance_criteria: All 9 geometry error codes are emitted by validateGeometry with appropriate checks
GenerateActualBomButton uses currentSnapshot.id as snapshotId, not project ID
Integration tests exercise runPipeline through store with mocked Supabase
All three dialogs check { error } from insert and show error state on failure
runPipeline catch block surfaces structured errors in pipelineErrors
reconcileBomLines preserves per-zone traceability via componentId in merge key
Aspect ratio warning only fires when maxAspectRatio is explicitly configured
verification: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
findings: All 673 tests pass (643 original + 24 pipeline integration + 5 store integration + 1 new button test). TypeScript strict mode clean. The site adaptation engine requires zone widths to sum to template_wall_width, and zone positions are not updated after adaptation (only widths change). GeometryZone interface extended with optional panelWidth, panelHeight, gapHorizontal, gapVertical fields. WallDimensions extended with maxZoneDimension, minGap, maxGap, minPanelDimension, maxPanelDimension, minRetainedWidth, checkTotalDimensions.
